description: This file defines the BarrierCoordinator class for handling global synchronization requests in Spark's barrier stage implementation. It manages barrier requests, timeouts, and stage attempt states, facilitating coordination among tasks in barrier stages.

classes.name: ContextBarrierId
classes.description: Identifies a specific barrier stage attempt using stageId and stageAttemptId.

classes.name: BarrierCoordinator
classes.description: Coordinates global barrier requests, manages stage attempt states, handles timeouts, and responds to barrier synchronization requests.

classes.name: ContextBarrierState
classes.description: Maintains state for a specific barrier stage attempt, including requesters, messages, barrier epoch, and timeout handling.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Initializes the listener for stage completion events.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources, cancels timers, and removes listeners.

methods.name: cleanupBarrierStage
methods.description: Removes and clears the state for a specific stage attempt.

methods.name: receiveAndReply
methods.description: Handles incoming barrier sync requests and routes them to the appropriate stage attempt state.
